test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 18 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some superstars are actors.

Some superstars are writers.

Some actors are producers.

Conclusions:

(I): Some superstars are producers.

(II): Some actors are writers.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76516778b190718cccb432a9e47cb270c289678f6c00d6c835b5d1f112bf0830.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): Some superstars are producers → False(As, there is no direct relation between them)

(II): Some actors are writers → False(As, there is no direct relation between them)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
